steps.action: Deployment sets SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM: the wizard relay settings are read-only and the environment wins
steps.expected: No Save relay, Replace relay or Clear relay; mail is sent from the environment sender, not the stored one
steps.actual: The Outbound email step read "Outbound email is set by the deployment environment. Mail is sent from DOC-029 Environment <env-relay@helix.example>." with the hint that settings saved here never apply. An invitation from the Invite your team step arrived from env-relay@helix.example, not from the stored stored-relay@helix.example.
